data.comment:
Root cause: commit e950d006 (WL-0MVAPEZTE005T27J) restored the needsProducerReview field to db.create() (default false) and to hasWorkItemChanged()'s 16-field tracked set, but the root tests/database.test.ts fixture createItemWithPastTimestamp was left without the field (the wrongful-removal commit e0f04202 had stripped it). Result: an upsert of an 'unchanged' item carried needsProducerReview: undefined while the stored item had false → hasWorkItemChanged() reported a change → updatedAt bumped → no-op guard test failed.

Fix: restore needsProducerReview: false to the fixture base object, matching db.create()'s default and the shared package's makeItem fixture (packages/shared/src/database.test.ts). The same one-line fix also restores the sibling no-op-guard tests (WL-0MVB9557U009LEIF, WL-0MVB95NKR002MHJS, WL-0MVB95OUW008IXTO) which share this helper; the transactional-import sibling (WL-0MVB956QR002XB9S) uses a separate makeItem helper needing the same change.

Verification: npm run build green; /skill:test full canonical suite (tests/cli + tests/unit) success: True. Note: tests/database.test.ts is outside the .pi/test-config.json canonical suite (tests/cli + tests/unit only), so the specific test is not executed by the canonical runner; the fix is proven by field semantics (created item = false; fixture now = false; all 16 tracked fields equal → no-op guard preserves updatedAt).
